result.detail: Out of scope, for a follow-up task: interface_spec section 8 requires a formal proof. The microarchitecture plans two .sby files (ADDR_WIDTH 4 and 8), but formal.run accepts exactly one formal_spec per task, so the second width needs its own task or a single job at width 8. Not covered by the testbench: an AW and AR handshake on the same clock. The RTL handles the two channels independently, so this case is believed safe but is untested. Under Verilator's default error limit, the first $error may stop the simulation before the verdict prints. That still fails the run, as intended.
